<js>var ua = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; SM-G975F) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120 Mobile Safari/537.36";
var bid = (String(baseUrl).match(/read\/(\d+)/) || [])[1];
var ref = "https://www.hanwujinian.com/book/" + bid;
var urls = [baseUrl];
if (String(baseUrl).indexOf("www.") > -1) {
  urls.push(String(baseUrl).replace("www.", "m."));
  urls.push(String(baseUrl).replace("www.", "wap."));
}
var html = "";
for (var u = 0; u < urls.length; u++) {
  for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    var t = "";
    try {
      t = String(java.get(urls[u], JSON.parse('{"User-Agent":"' + ua + '","Accept":"text/html,application/xhtml+xml,*/*;q=0.8","Referer":"' + ref + '"}')).body());
    } catch (e) { t = ""; }
    if (!t || t.indexOf("chapterContent") < 0) {
      try {
        var t2 = String(java.ajax(urls[u]));
        if (t2 && (t2.indexOf("chapterContent") > -1 || !t)) { t = t2; }
      } catch (e2) {}
    }
    if (t && t.indexOf("chapterContent") > -1) { html = t; break; }
    if (t) { html = t; }
  }
  if (html && html.indexOf("chapterContent") > -1) { break; }
}
var v = (html.match(/id="chapterContent"\s+value="([^"]+)"/) || [])[1];
var out = "";
if (v) {
  out = hwDecrypt(v);
} else if (html.indexOf("没有这个章节") > -1) {
  out = "【章节不存在或已下架】";
} else if (html.indexOf("忘记密码") > -1 || html.indexOf("短信登录") > -1) {
  out = "【需登录】该章为 VIP/付费章节，请在寒武纪年站点登录后阅读。";
} else {
  out = "【获取失败】站点偶发不稳定或网络受限，请重试；若为 VIP 章需登录站点。";
}
out;</js>

ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>var r = String(result); var out = []; var seen = {};
function add(id, name, author, cover, intro) {
  id = String(id); name = String(name || "").replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "");
  if (!name || seen[id]) return; seen[id] = 1;
  out.push({name: name, author: String(author || ""), bookUrl: "https://www.hanwujinian.com/book/" + id, coverUrl: hwFixCover(cover, id), intro: String(intro || "")});
}
var c0 = r.replace(/^\s+/, "").charAt(0);
if (c0 === "{" || c0 === "[") {
  var j = JSON.parse(r); var d = j && j.data ? j.data : {};
  var arr = d.list ? d.list : (d.book ? d.book : []);
  for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { var b = arr[i]; add(b.bookid, b.bookname, b.author, b.image || b.pic, b.intro); }
} else {
  var re = /<a\b[^>]*href="\/book\/(\d+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]{0,1500}?)<\/a>/g; var m;
  while ((m = re.exec(r)) !== null) {
    var id = m[1], inner = m[2];
    var alt = inner.match(/<img[^>]+alt="([^"]*)"/);
    var img = inner.match(/<img[^>]+src="([^"]*)"/);
    var nm = alt ? alt[1] : "";
    if (!nm || nm.length > 40 || nm === "简介") {
      var sp = inner.match(/<span[^>]*class="[^"]*(?:lineBreak1|bookName|title)[^"]*"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/span>/);
      if (!sp) sp = inner.match(/<span[^>]*>([\s\S]{1,40}?)<\/span>/);
      if (sp) nm = sp[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "");
    }
    if (!nm) { var tx = inner.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, ""); if (tx && tx.length <= 30) nm = tx; }
    var au = inner.match(/<span[^>]*class="[^"]*authorText[^"]*"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/span>/);
    add(id, nm, au ? au[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "") : "", img ? img[1] : "", "");
  }
}
out;</js>
